title: rewrite a merged change as a reviewer sentence
provenance: The squash-commit description of a real merged change, omniintelligence 56f099028bda36ec8e270972953e748548158d6b.
prompt:
Rewrite this merged change's description as a one-sentence summary a reviewer can read in five seconds. Keep the ticket identifier OMN-16691 and the name `OMNI_TRUSTED_CI_RUNS_ON_JSON` exactly as written. Add nothing the description does not state. At most 35 words.

CHANGE (omniintelligence#854):
fix(OMN-16691): pin occ-*-manual-replay off the shared runner seam (OMN-16682 carried-forward item 1)

* fix(OMN-16691): pin occ-*-manual-replay off the shared runner seam (OMN-16682 carried-forward item 1)

Both occ-*-manual-replay jobs read the shared
`OMNI_TRUSTED_CI_RUNS_ON_JSON` seam while hardcoding
RUNNER_IS_TRUSTED=true. That seam is now `["ubuntu-latest"]`, so these
jobs land on a runner that cannot resolve the tailnet-only dev-lane
broker and fail loud -- the recovery path for an OCC autobind outage is
dead exactly when an outage makes it necessary.

Re-points both to the dedicated `OMNI_OCC_AUTOBIND_RUNS_ON_JSON` knob
with the literal `["self-hosted","omnibase-ci"]` fallback, matching the
carve-out omniclaude#2051 landed on the reusables these jobs mirror.
The variable is deliberately unset at org and repo scope, so the literal
is the operating value and the pin holds by construction.

Mechanical: one `runs-on:` line plus its rationale comment per job. No
other job, trigger, permission, or step changed.

* chore(OMN-16682): bind this PR's identity to OMN-16682 for the receipt gate

The OCC companion stamps `Evidence-Ticket: OMN-16682` (this work is that
ticket's carried-forward item 1), while the branch is named for OMN-16691.
The receipt gate's identity-binding leg accepts either a branch name or a
commit message naming the Evidence-Ticket, and reported
`commit messages checked=0` on the hosted runner. This commit is the
remedy the gate itself prescribes.

No file changes.

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
